folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B419: complete plan, later direction and actual scope
folds.body:
The complete saved plan is now content-reviewed: B418 actually read1–615, its exact prefix is unchanged, and this continuation reads616–1194 including all remaining CL129–CL281 rows, coordination history and prior reconciliation sections. Those prior partial-review labels describe the state at their dates; this full review supersedes them without upgrading any linked source/runtime evidence.

**Direction and supersession:** CL157–CL160’s NPC-first order is replaced inside this document by the user’s CL268 lead-first direction and then AD44; CL214’s second-case admission gate is explicitly replaced in round15 and current AD51. Keep the be/beside/follow/bystander possibilities; current PROJECT gives Klein’s developer route priority, HP alongside and low-spoiler ordinary starts later. A useful world-specific mechanism can retain its semantics or share the fitting frame; another case validates/revises rather than grants permission. CL226’s be-seat question is answered by round17. CL123/CL194/CL198/CL281’s acceptance questions are historical: the present [rules register](../../../RULES_INDEX.md) records CLR1–CLR13, SUI1–SUI19 and RPT1–RPT12 as binding defaults, with RPT13–RPT14 later standing rules. No repeat approval or new adoption is needed from this read.

**Actual coverage and publication:** CL141 correctly identifies a public-source/canon-data placement defect; CL142 records the user’s later keep-history decision. Do not infer permission to rewrite history or publish any data now. Private pack content, public generic source, existing local history and actual installed/build publication are separate. CL153’s blanket load-without-pack promise is a design intention, not a guarantee for pending jobs: later mechanism receipts require the exact matching owner/definition for pending validation and leave pack-loss recovery unchanged. Stable crosswalk addresses do not by themselves preserve every changed instance, commitment or command revision. The current rule owner governs deliberate quotations and reader presentation; a private provenance class is not a new blanket display policy.

**Fidelity and effects:** preserve CL171–CL177’s choices, inputs/output, causal time/order, actual participants/place, outcome/risk and observable information. A coarse fold can be clean where it truly preserves those meanings; a record/marker is not a paid purchase or executable choice. The earlier scene prose examples and claimed0-of18 score remain dated, not today’s source count or a reason to infer current absence. CL258’s any-actor design is useful, but untaken options still need real supported nouns, rules, means and outcomes; extra integration is not automatically free. CL189’s no-save-change split is conditional on the actual saved mapping/definition contracts, not a universal migration promise. A required first-class book mechanic remains actual engine/consumer work even if a report fragment is useful.

**Time, knowledge and world scope:** story time, locator order, remembered past, actual future event and a fallible vision are distinct. A flashback is not automatically something this actor remembers; an omniscient future scene is not automatically player knowledge, while a truly exact faculty need not be made uncertain. Dream context is world-qualified and need not be a physically separate realm; body position, observer, control and return follow its mechanism. CL260’s blanket every-draw keyed claim and CL261’s per-life variation are proposed policies, not a fresh audit of legacy streams or every RNG consumer. Reproducibility needs actual instance/attempt identity and owned settlement, with legitimate new attempts preserved. Divergence remains open through real mechanisms and supported means rather than a promise that any stated outcome is always attainable.

**Execution and continuation:** the full plan is dated design/coordination history. CL103/CL129’s CLI and usage numbers, historical launch/commit/status lines, rigid count stops, old reading-credit deadline and two-writer proposals are not current state or new authorization. The one-page card/handoff and actual runtime/source owners remain the working entry surfaces. The original narrow slice, MoL structural fit, return/clock policies and wider-world ambitions stay separate from a whole-world completion claim. Full document review here proves none of natural source acquisition, private-pack parity, rebuilt desktop behavior, persistence, installation, commit or deployment.
